newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - March 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - March 6.

text.p: These were the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Tamil trainee at state-owned Rupavahini television station in police custody for possessing forged national identity card.
High powered ministerial sub-committee appointed to examine salary issues of striking government doctors.
Three-month old strike at Coca Cola plant ends.
D.M. Seneviratne appointed as ruling coalition's new MP for Ratnapura district after death of Nalanda Ellawala, who was assassinated in February.
Customs seize three foreign cars cut in half and packed in containers.
Armed gang of four hijack vehicle in Yala safari park in southern Sri Lanka.
